clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau points to a doctor named Darrell Stoddard, who worked with more than 30,000 chronic pain patients.

His finding: most of them were simply dehydrated. Once they got properly hydrated, the pain started to lift - joint pain, back pain, headaches, all of it.

His explanation: dehydration drives more pain than most people realize, and water is the first thing to check before anything else.

Your body is 70% water. When was the last time you drank a full glass that wasn't coffee, tea or juice?
